questions.source_content:
ADMINISTRATIVE CIRCULAR
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Jaipur
Date: 23 September 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/230)
Subject: Modernization of Agricultural Mandis and Online Commodity Assaying Facilities (Phase-3)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Jaipur division are hereby informed that under 'Modernization of Agricultural Mandis and Online Commodity Assaying Facilities', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 8 September in the central nodal wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #330) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Jaipur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and nodal movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Jaipur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #140, 3. Digital Indexing.
District Supply Officer
Arjun Kumar Sharma
solution_steps: 1. Go to INSERT -> Header/Footer and Page Number.
2. Go to DESIGN -> Watermark (and Page Border).

Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Jaipur
Date: 23 September 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/230)
Subject: Modernization of Agricultural Mandis and Online Commodity Assaying Facilities (Phase-3)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Jaipur division are hereby informed that under 'Modernization of Agricultural Mandis and Online Commodity Assaying Facilities', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 8 September in the central nodal wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #330) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Jaipur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and nodal movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Jaipur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #140, 3. Digital Indexing.
District Supply Officer
Arjun Kumar Sharma
solution_steps: 1. Select the Key Action Points line.
2. Choose Capitalize Each Word, Underline, and Font Color.
